request.style: English, traditional storytelling folk, weathered male vocal, acoustic guitar, harmonica, upright bass, fiddle, frame drum, earnest and epic, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
His mother hid him three months long till she could hide no more
She laid him in a papyrus basket by the Nile's reedy shore
His sister watched from a distance as Pharaoh's daughter came
I drew him out of the water, and Moses was his name

[Verse]
He kept the flock of Jethro, and at Horeb's mountain height
He saw a bush that burned but was not consumed, a great sight
God called to him out of the bush, and he stood on holy ground
The LORD had seen his people's misery and heard their cry resound

[Chorus]
I AM WHO I AM
I AM has sent me to you
This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says
Let my people go

[Verse]
On Sinai there was thunder and the mountain shook with fire
The horn grew loud and louder as the smoke rose ever higher
I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt
You shall have no other gods before me

[Chorus]
I AM WHO I AM
I AM has sent me to you
This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says
Let my people go

[Verse]
He climbed Mount Nebo, Pisgah's top, and looked across the land
From Gilead as far as Dan, down to the Negev sand
I have let you see it with your own eyes
But you will not cross over into it

[Outro]
So Moses, the servant of the LORD, died there in the land of Moab
Let my people go
